ventures.name: Slate
ventures.pitch: Turns voice notes into client-ready briefs
ventures.problem: Freelancers spend hours turning messy client calls into structured briefs. It's tedious and error-prone.
ventures.who: Freelance designers, developers, and consultants who juggle multiple clients.
ventures.why: I was that freelancer. Lost a client because I missed a key requirement buried in a 45-minute call.

pitch.body: Slate records your client calls, transcribes them with AI, and generates structured briefs automatically. No more 'I thought you said...' moments.

spark.body: Lost a $15k project because I misunderstood scope. The client said 'mobile-first' and I heard 'mobile too'. Three weeks of work, thrown away.

validation.body: Talked to 47 freelancers. 43 said they'd pay for this. The other 4 were lying.

ventures.name: Paykit
ventures.pitch: Accept payments in Africa without the headache
ventures.problem: Accepting payments in African markets requires integrating 15 different providers. Each with terrible docs.
ventures.who: SaaS companies expanding into African markets.
ventures.why: Spent 6 months at my last startup just on payment integrations. Never again.

pitch.body: One API for payments across 20 African countries. M-Pesa, bank transfers, cards - all unified.

spark.body: Our startup was growing fast in Kenya. Then we tried Nigeria. Three months just to accept naira. We almost gave up.

launch.body: Launched on Twitter at 6am Lagos time. By noon we had 12 signups. By evening, 89. Couldn't believe it.

ventures.name: Forma
ventures.pitch: Design system management for growing teams
ventures.problem: Design systems break down as teams grow. Components drift. Nobody knows what's current.
ventures.who: Product teams with 5-50 designers and developers.
ventures.why: Led design systems at two startups. Watched both collapse under their own weight.

pitch.body: Forma syncs your Figma with your codebase. When designers update a component, developers see it instantly. No more drift.

first.body: First paying customer: a fintech in São Paulo. $299/month. I cried in the shower.

ventures.name: Mise
ventures.pitch: Recipe scaling and costing for restaurants
ventures.problem: Chefs scale recipes by gut feel. Then wonder why margins are thin.
ventures.who: Restaurant owners and head chefs managing food costs.
ventures.why: Ran a restaurant for 8 years. Discovered we were losing money on our most popular dish.

pitch.body: Mise tracks ingredient costs in real-time and tells you exactly how much each dish costs to make. Scale recipes up or down with perfect proportions.

proto.body: Built the first version in a spreadsheet. Used it at my own restaurant for a month. Found three dishes that were underwater.

ventures.name: Verdant
ventures.problem: Enterprise carbon tracking tools cost $100k+. Small manufacturers can't afford to measure, so they don't.
ventures.who: Small to medium manufacturers who want to prove their sustainability claims.
ventures.why: Worked in sustainability consulting. Watched small suppliers lose contracts because they couldn't prove carbon numbers.

pitch.body: Verdant connects to your existing systems - ERP, energy meters, logistics - and automatically calculates your carbon footprint. No consultants required.

ventures.name: Cohort
ventures.problem: Course creators have no idea which students will drop off until they're gone.
ventures.why: Built three courses. Lost 60% of students by week 3. Had no warning signs.

pitch.body: Cohort predicts which students are at risk of dropping out and tells you exactly when to intervene. Keep more students, make more impact.

channel.body: Twitter threads about student retention. Each one brings 20-30 signups. Finally found what works.

ventures.name: Lumina
ventures.pitch: AI meeting notes that actually capture context
ventures.problem: Current AI note-takers just transcribe. They miss the subtext, the decisions, the action items buried in tangents.
ventures.who: Product managers and founders who live in meetings.
ventures.why: Spent 2 hours after every meeting writing notes. Then nobody read them anyway.

pitch.body: Lumina understands your meeting context - who's who, what projects matter, what was decided before. Notes that actually make sense.

beta.body: Gave it to 15 PMs. They found bugs I never imagined. One guy broke it with a 4-hour meeting. Who has 4-hour meetings?

ventures.name: Klass
ventures.problem: Teachers spend 10+ hours a week on lesson planning. Most of that time is formatting and finding resources.
ventures.who: K-12 teachers drowning in admin work.
ventures.why: My wife is a teacher. She works until 11pm most nights. I had to do something.

pitch.body: Klass generates complete lesson plans aligned to your curriculum. Slides, worksheets, assessments - all done in minutes.

build.body: Learning about curriculum standards. There are 47 different state standards in the US alone. This is harder than I thought.

ventures.name: Tensor
ventures.pitch: ML model deployment without the DevOps
ventures.problem: Data scientists build great models. Then wait months for engineering to deploy them.
ventures.who: ML teams at mid-size companies without dedicated MLOps.
ventures.why: Was a data scientist. Watched my best model sit in a notebook for 8 months. It never shipped.

pitch.body: Tensor deploys your Jupyter notebook as a production API in one click. Auto-scaling, monitoring, versioning - all handled.

first.body: A healthcare startup paid us $500/month. Their model was predicting patient no-shows. Now it actually runs in production.

ventures.name: Zinc
ventures.problem: Enterprise expense tools are overkill. Spreadsheets are chaos. Bootstrapped founders need something in between.
ventures.who: Bootstrapped founders spending their own money carefully.
ventures.why: Bootstrapped two startups. Lost track of expenses both times. Tax season was a nightmare.

pitch.body: Zinc is dead simple expense tracking for founders. Snap receipts, categorize spending, know exactly where your runway is going.
